import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the gsl_function structure
class GSLFunction(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('function', ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_void_p)),
                ('params', ctypes.c_void_p)]

# Define the function to integrate
@ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_void_p)
def my_function(x, params):
    return np.sin(x)

# Create a GSL function instance
f = GSLFunction(function=my_function, params=None)

# Allocate workspace
gsl.gsl_integration_workspace_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)
workspace = gsl.gsl_integration_workspace_alloc(1000)

# Define the integration function
def integrate_function(f, a, b, epsabs, epsrel, limit):
    result = ctypes.c_double()
    abserr = ctypes.c_double()
    status = gsl.gsl_integration_qags(ctypes.byref(f), ctypes.c_double(a), ctypes.c_double(b),
                                      ctypes.c_double(epsabs), ctypes.c_double(epsrel),
                                      ctypes.c_size_t(limit), workspace, ctypes.byref(result), ctypes.byref(abserr))
    if status != 0:
        raise RuntimeError('Integration failed with status {}'.format(status))
    return result.value, abserr.value

# Free workspace memory
def free_workspace():
    gsl.gsl_integration_workspace_free(workspace)

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    try:
        # Test integration of sin(x) from 0 to pi
        result, error = integrate_function(f, 0, np.pi, 1e-7, 1e-7, 1000)
        assert np.isclose(result, 2.0, atol=1e-7), f"Expected 2.0, got {result}"
        assert error < 1e-7, f"Expected error < 1e-7, got {error}"

        # Test integration of sin(x) from 0 to 2*pi
        result, error = integrate_function(f, 0, 2*np.pi, 1e-7, 1e-7, 1000)
        assert np.isclose(result, 0.0, atol=1e-7), f"Expected 0.0, got {result}"
        assert error < 1e-7, f"Expected error < 1e-7, got {error}"
    finally:
        free_workspace()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
